strings.en:
{0c:2b542352ffffca982b501000}{1c:13}{0b:08}【 Valdes 】{0b:09}
Back then this town was sick: more
folks died killin' each other than got killed
by monsters.{1a}{0c:52a0a8}I was desperate. I killed people to stay
alive. But somehow I never felt a lick of
guilt.{1a}{0c:52b0b8}I kept fightin' like mad, the monsters and
the grown men around me, and kept
earnin' money for my six little brothers
and sisters waitin' back home.{1a}{0c:52c0c8}But it seems not a year after I left
home, the kids were killed by the priest
at the church that was lookin' after 'em.{1a}{0c:52d0d8}Makes sense, when you think about it.
What you can earn here in a month is
more than three years' worth for a
normal farmer.{1a}{0c:52e0e8}Blinded by money, that priest held one of
Tradoa's famous Holy Tribunals and had
every last one of 'em executed, or so
the story goes.{1a}{0c:52f0f8}I knew nothin' about it and kept sendin'
that priest money for four whole years.{1a}{0c:52ff01ff09}When he dropped dead of old age and I
found out from a letter from the priest
who took over, I went pretty wild, I'll say
that. I got sick of everything.{1a}{0c:52ff11ff19}That what I'd done meanin' well got the
kids killed, that a man I trusted had
betrayed me...{1a}{0c:52ff21ff29}But at the same time, I learned
somethin' obvious for the first time:
everybody I'd killed had a life of their
own.{1a}{0c:52ff31ff39}I ain't killed a single person since... Well,
that's a lie,{1a}{0c:52ff41ff49}but it's true I started thinkin', at least
a little, about what another person's life
weighs.{0c:fe}
strings.tl: Back then this town was sick: more folks died killin' each other than got killed by monsters. // [1]I was desperate. I killed people to stay alive. But somehow I never felt a lick of guilt. // [2]I kept fightin' like mad, the monsters and the grown men around me, and kept earnin' money for my six little brothers and sisters waitin' back home. // [3]But it seems not a year after I left home, the kids were killed by the priest at the church that was lookin' after 'em. // [4]Makes sense, when you think about it. What you can earn here in a month is more than three years' worth for a normal farmer. // [5]Blinded by money, that priest held one of Tradoa's famous Holy Tribunals and had every last one of 'em executed, or so the story goes. // [6]I knew nothin' about it and kept sendin' that priest money for four whole years. // [7]When he dropped dead of old age and I found out from a letter from the priest who took over, I went pretty wild, I'll say that. I got sick of everything. // [8]That what I'd done meanin' well got the kids killed, that a man I trusted had betrayed me... // [9]But at the same time, I learned somethin' obvious for the first time: everybody I'd killed had a life of their own. // [10]I ain't killed a single person since... Well, that's a lie, // [11]but it's true I started thinkin', at least a little, about what another person's life weighs.
Come to think of it, there was somethin' like that, wasn't there...
